newsitem.title: UK: Conservative Scottish MP Stewart resigns seat.
newsitem.headline: Conservative Scottish MP Stewart resigns seat.

text.p: The MP in the safest Conservative seat in Scotland has resigned his seat just five weeks before the May 1 national election.

Allan Stewart said in a statement he would not seek re-election as an MP in his Eastwood, Glasgow, seat because of press reports about his health and personal life had caused "great family distress and personal strain".
Recent press reports have linked Stewart with a married woman he is said to have met at a clinic specialising in alcohol problems.

Stewart, 54, first entered parliament in 1979 and held the Eastwood seat with a majority of 11,688 in the 1992 election. He was a junior minister in the Scottish office before resigning in 1995 after a court appearance for a pick-axe confrontation with roads protesters.
